Title: Public Preview: Microsoft Copilot now offers supportability in Azure Database for MySQL

Body.Content:
This experience adds Azure Database for MySQL skills into Microsoft Copilot in Azure, empowering you with self-guided assistance with the ability to solve issues independently. 

Learn more.
